name: Bela krajina skozi ljudsko pripoved
snippet: Feb 22, 2008 — Bela krajina skozi ljudsko pripoved ... Glavna nit predstavitve je ljudska pripoved, vezana za posamezne vasi in naselja oz. njihove prebivalce.

name: Pond in Griblje
snippet: This small, but beautiful, pond is not well known, except to locals. It lies in the fields between the villages of Griblje and Krasinec.
